metadata.modification_notes: SHR Drums Power Studio 1.0: selected layers/round robins; resampled 48 kHz stereo PCM24; onset/tail trims; filtering; linked parallel compression and saturation on drums; mild cymbal saturation; generated kick reinforcement and original clap/tambourine/splash/cowbell. Pitched Tom4 (-2) and Tom1 (+2) variants; truncated choked-crash variant. No endorsement implied.
